protocol.trading_target: next observed close / next observed open - 1
protocol.execution: Long/cash, entry next open, exit same close, no shorting.
protocol.selection: 2021-2023 train, 2024 validation; final 2021-2024; 2025-2026 test, disjoint issuers; outcomes mature strictly before next split.
protocol.same_day_eod_assumption: Historical daily bars and market closes assumed available by 18:00; actual archive publication clocks are not universally recorded.
protocol.headline_policy: Issuer-verified archived headlines, preceding calendar dates only, trailing 7 days; empty coverage remains missing.
protocol.news_limit: Published timestamp permits retrospective reconstruction; retrieval was later, and archive coverage is sparse and not exhaustive.
